description: All naturals form an infinite pseudointersection of the tails \(\{m:m\ge n\}\), and the exception set for tail \(n\) is exactly \(\{m:m<n\}\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.FiniteErrorsAndCountableDiagonalization.tails_pseudointersection :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.IsPseudointersection (Set.range fun n => Set.Ici n) Set.univ ∧
    ∀ (n : ℕ), Set.univ \ Set.Ici n = Set.Iio n
